notes: Churches of Christ congregation at 10th St and Country Club Rd, meeting there since 1 Jan 1950 (per its own About page). Address 145 N. Country Club Road, Tucson AZ 85716 confirmed from the site footer. Preacher: the sermon archive (1,240 sermons, filterable by speaker) shows Reagan Bingham preaching essentially every Sunday morning and evening through 2026 - every one of the 25 most recent entries, from 2026-05-17 to 2026-09-06, is his. The site publishes no staff or leadership page and gives him no formal title, so 'Preacher' is used here rather than a title the church does not claim; it lists no elders publicly either. The long speaker list on the archive page is mostly visiting gospel-meeting speakers (Allen Greeley, Bill Robinson, Buddy Payne, Zeke Flores and others), not regular preachers - do not add them. CAUTION: ccrcoc.com also styles itself 'Country Club Road Church of Christ' and is a DIFFERENT congregation; use churchofchristtucson.org only. Media: sermon audio on the church site with an RSS podcast feed, plus a YouTube channel (@churchofchristtucson) whose uploads playlist is recorded above; caption availability untested.
